historical_data_manager_activation.description: Toggles for enabling/disabling specific functionalities of HistoricalDataManager.

run_metric_orchestration.description: Master toggle for the entire metric orchestration process.

ensure_ohlcv_fallbacks.description: Toggle for ensuring OHLCV fallback logic.

core_structural_metrics.description: Phase toggle for core structural metrics (DAG, TDPI, VRI-Sensitivity).

calculate_tdpi_suite.description: Specific toggle for TDPI suite (TDPI, CTR, TDFI).

sdag_methodologies.description: Toggles for SDAG methodologies phase and individual methods.

enabled_phase.description: Master toggle for the entire SDAG calculation phase.

0dte_suite.description: Toggles for 0DTE specific metrics phase and individual metrics.

enabled_phase.description: Master toggle for the 0DTE suite calculation phase.

flow_metrics_nvp_arfi.description: Toggles for strike-level flow metrics NVP and ARFI.

mspi_suite_calculation.description: Toggles for the MSPI suite (weights, MSPI, SAI, SSI).

calculate_all_underlying_aggregates.description: Master toggle for all underlying aggregate calculations.

dealer_positioning_metrics.description: Toggles for dealer positioning metrics (GIB, tdGIB, HP_EOD).

vci_0dte_aggregation.description: Toggle for final VCI_0DTE aggregation at underlying level.

aggregate_strike_metrics_to_und.description: Toggle for aggregating strike-level metrics (like MSPI sums/means) to the underlying level.
